verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no published per-TLD price list showing separate registration, renewal and transfer prices, and nothing on renewal versus first-year pricing. The reseller page only says resellers can set their own registration, transfer and renewal prices. The transfer page mentions a 1-year renewal included with a transfer. Neither is a public price list, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, the full price list is published — registration, renewal, and transfer priced separately per TLD, with no teaser first-year price hiding a renewal spike
